summary: Prompt 2 (ONE CANONICAL JOB + SAFE MIGRATION) verified. Backend: pytest tests/test_prompt2_canonical.py 13/13 pass; new tests/test_prompt2_api_sanity.py 9/9 pass against the public URL (owner-only migration endpoints, booking-state, mark-booked-override 422 reason gate, cancel-job 404, 401/403 on unauth). Frontend: /migration-review renders for owner with title, mig-scan-btn, mig-run-btn, mig-counts and all six mig-count-* tiles (Scanned, Already linked, Linked now, Ambiguous, Skipped, Failed). Dry-run scan shows success toast 'Dry-run scan complete.', populates counts (scanned=2, skipped=2, others=0), 'Nothing to review' empty state renders. Mobile 390x844 has no horizontal overflow. RBAC: clearing storage and visiting /migration-review falls back to Login screen; owner-only migration API returns 403 without token. Owner Dashboard + sidebar nav still work, no page crashes. Override dialog validation is confirmed via code review (disabled={overrideReason.trim().length < 5}) and backend 422 test; could NOT interactively click the override/book-as-job path because all 3 preview leads are already status=Booked (expected — override and book-btn hide/disable on booked leads).
verified_flows: Owner login (HaulYeahAdmin/HaulYeah2026!) -> nav shows 'Migration Review' entry (Business group).
/migration-review renders: title, mig-scan-btn, mig-run-btn, mig-counts region with 6 tiles.
mig-scan-btn (dry-run) -> toast 'Dry-run scan complete.', mig-count-scanned=2, no crash.
'Nothing to review — every job is either linked or waiting for a deposit.' empty state visible.
Mobile 390x844: no horizontal overflow on migration review page.
RBAC without auth: /migration-review redirects/falls back to login screen; /api/migration/status without token returns 403.

Backend API sanity (9/9) via public URL: /api/migration/project-ids/scan 200 w/ counts, /api/migration/status 200 w/ last_scan+pending_review, /api/migration/review 200 w/ items[], /api/leads/anyid/booking-state -> booking_state:'none',booked:false, /api/leads/x/mark-booked-override reason 'no' -> 422, /api/jobs/nope/cancel -> 404, unauth migration -> 403.
Owner Dashboard regression: loads cleanly, sidebar nav functional, no console/page errors on touched pages.
critical_code_review_comments: Preview DB has all 3 leads at status=Booked so interactive 'Mark booked (override)' dialog and 'Book as job' 403-toast paths cannot be exercised in UI. Code review confirms correct wiring: LeadDetail.jsx line 406 gates override btn on status !== 'Booked' and line 483 gates confirm on overrideReason.trim().length < 5 (matches spec >=5 chars).

Spec wording vs backend naming: scan response uses 'deterministically_linked' while spec/UI label it 'Linked now'. Frontend MigrationReview.jsx correctly reads scan.deterministically_linked and labels tile 'Linked now' — no change needed; just noting the naming divergence between spec text and payload.
Non-blocking: 2 console 401 errors appear on initial pre-login /auth/me request — expected behavior but noisy.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of testable flows (override dialog interactive path not reachable: preview data limitation)

The Airtable PAT is read-only so any Project-create write returns 403 by design — this surfaces as a toast and the backend logs; no action needed.
